name: The Feathered Serpent Observatory
description: A colossal stone serpent carved with constellations lies across the desert, its eyes are twin observatory domes that project maps of the cosmos onto the night sky.
prompt: A grand and mythological scene in a vast desert at night. A colossal stone serpent, carved in the style of ancient Mesoamerican art, stretches across the sand, its body covered in intricate carvings of stars, planets, and mythical creatures. Its two enormous, jewel-like eyes are actual observatory domes, glowing with a soft blue light. From these eyes, beams of light project detailed maps of constellations and galaxies directly onto the star-filled night sky above, making the heavens look even more alive and informative. The serpent's open mouth reveals a dark, mysterious interior that seems to lead to a hidden chamber. The scene is awe-inspiring and full of ancient wisdom. Highly detailed digital art with a rich, dark color palette lit by starlight.
caption: Ancient stone holds the secrets of the cosmos. Gaze into its eyes and read the map of the universe. 🐍✨
